boundsMeaning: Projected envelope of requested geographic rectangle, rounded outward on frozen R03 30m lattice; tiny extra border is deliberate
verticalConversion: none; source already EGM2008; no HKPD conversion API used
sourceGridSpacing: 1 arc-second, approximately 28.61m east-west × 30.76m north-south at latitude22.375°
sourceType: Edited digital surface model (DSM), includes vegetation/buildings, not bare-earth DTM
product: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 Public AWS 2021 release, matched to existing east tile
heightResampling: GDAL bilinear horizontal reprojection only, exact coordinate transformer (errorThreshold=0)
waterResampling: Nearest-neighbour from matching official WBM; preserve classes0nonwater1ocean2lake3river255unknown; never infer sea from H=0
seaDisplayReference: EGM2008 display zero, no tide/bathymetry model; inland water keeps original surface heights
sourceTerrainAcquisitionWarning: Per-tile radar acquisition windows are not per-pixel survey dates. Gap-fill sources can be older. No historical shoreline reconstruction.
screenshotUse: Geographic extent reference only; no Google pixels sampled into height, mask, or texture

seamQA.integration_rule: Frozen current background and local 2m/5m details retain ownership inside their domains; this independent product fills exterior only by default. Do not replace old story edits.

sourceMetadataClarification.dates: Product generation, editing/analysis and metadata/release timestamps differ from radar acquisition. No per-pixel historical date inferred.
